pro_course_detail.description:
If you are unsure if this lesson type is available to you, please get in touch.


The CBLT approach is a student-centered teaching approach where the focus is on what learners are expected to DO with the language. In other words, mastering how to navigate situations like socializing with people on vacation, confronting a noisy neighbour, enquiring about a product/service, or even asking someone out on a date! 

For young learners, lesson themes could include how to discuss your hobbies in detail, weekend adventures with friends, responsibility, and/or future plans like getting a summer job. This lesson type is suitable for students at all language levels who are interested in improving their spoken English.  


In our classes, the focus is on mastering the language you will need in order to feel confident tackling daily situations in English. If you are the type of student who prefers to learn from grammar books or who priorities mastering grammar terminology over functional language, we may not be the best fit. But, if you are the type of student who would like to practise using English for real-life situations, I look forward to meeting you in class!

pro_course_detail.description:
Learn the fundamentals of news writing and how to write to the industry standard. As shown on my online course: https://www.udemy.com/course/news-writing-fundamentals-a-guide-to-news-writing/

This course is a step-by-step guide on how to write direct, effective and coherent news stories. For those interested in journalism, this class will equip you with an essential skill. While for those interested in developing their writing ability, you will find that this course will strengthen your writing through insight into how industry standard news stories are constructed. The ability to write directly and efficiently is not just applicable to the world of journalism, but across many professional fields.

The fundamental elements of news writing will be covered in this course; from headlines and intros, to how to incorporate quotations and structure your work. This course features examples throughout in order to help students understand the core concepts of news writing.

Course Overview:

Essential English - A breakdown of the essential principles of the English language that serve to strengthen our writing. 

Writing Headlines - Insight into how to best construct an effective headline in order to grab the attention of as many readers as possible. 

Writing Intros - An in depth dive into how to write news intros; the most important element of your news stories. 

Using Quotation - An overview of how to incorporate quotations into your writing in order to breathe life into your stories and provide validity to your work. 

Structure - A guide on how to bring together all the elements of a news story into a coherent piece of writing.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Scots
pro_course_detail.description:
*Please note, if you want to practice conversations in English with a Scottish teacher, this is not the correct course. Please see details of my English Conversation Practice course * 

This course is an introduction to the Scots language. 

Scots is one of 3 official languages (along with English and Scottish Gaelic) in Scotland. It is a minority language and one that we use a lot in conjunction with English. 

So if you plan to visit Scotland and want to know what you'll hear on the streets, book a lesson today. 

In this course you'll learn: 

- what Scots is and how it is used in Scotland
- the sounds of Scots
- the most common Scots words
- differences between the West and East coasts
- some basic grammar
- communicating in practical situations and reading real dialogues

To do this course, it would be best if you have at least B2 level of English as the instructions  and materials will be given in English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for University
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you planning on studying at a university in an English-speaking country? Or are you enrolled on a university Cours in your own country that is taught in English? If so, you should take this course so that you can gain the skills you need to study in English at university level. 

Academic English is not like general English - it has its own subtle rules and conventions and this applies to reading, writing, speaking, and listening. So, whether you are already enrolled on a course and want support with your essays or presentations, or you are due to start a university course soon, you can help, support, and practice with doing university tasks in English. 

We can start by talking about your strengths, weaknesses, and goals. Some of the things we can practice can include: 

Speaking - presentations, pair discussions, group discussions. 
Listening - Listening during a meeting and a lecture.
Writing - planning, structure, quoting, references, taking notes. 
Reading - reading for general message and for detail

I have teaching materials but we can use your own work or materials that you have been assigned. 

Requirements: You should already have at least B2 level of general English and have (or be working towards) your institution's required IELTS or TOEFL score. You should also make sure you have enough study time available between lessons. This course will require a lot of self study so you should make sure you have time to dedicate to it. 

Sign up today or book a trial lesson if you want to improve your English for academic study.

exp_info.description: Initially employed as a teaching assistant for the summer programme in 2020 - I have now gone on to provide one to one lessons to  support L2 language learners that are in the English school curriculum.  I also teach English group workshops which are held by the school.

cert_info.description: Having taught for a while at an international school, upon recommendation I decided to gain the official CELTA qualification this summer. This was a full time course. I thoroughly enjoyed participating and it has given a great foundation for teaching online.

pro_course_detail.title: English Lesson - materials provided A2 - C1
pro_course_detail.description: During this lesson we will discuss different topics, work on grammar, reading, pronunciation and do different activities to improve your spoken English.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation practice
pro_course_detail.description: This is a class purely for conversation practice. I can provide topics for everyday use and we will discuss these. I will help you by correcting your grammar and pronunciation as we speak. Ideal for students who are B1 - C2 level.
